idea-plugin.name: XOOPS Support
idea-plugin.description:
XOOPS Support brings XOOPS CMS knowledge into PhpStorm and IntelliJ IDEA: it finds the mistakes that break XOOPS modules and fixes most of them with one Alt+Enter. It covers XOOPS 2.5, 2.7, 2.8 and 4.0, for core and module development.

Every quick-fix is tested against whole-file fixtures and applied twice to prove it is idempotent. Before release the full set was run on 224 real modules: 46,000 findings and 10,000 files rewritten, with no entry point blocked and no parse error.

52 inspections with quick-fixes

  • Database: migrates queryF() and quoteString(), picks query() or exec() from the SQL, adds result-set guards that keep the function's failure contract, and flags ORDER BY or request-in-SQL injection.
  • Security: Xmf\Request instead of raw superglobals, missing CSRF checks, unserialize() without allowed_classes, dynamic code, weak tokens, path containment and attribute escaping.
  • Bootstrap and structure: direct-access guards that never block an entry point, double xoops_cp_header(), form loader, admin menu autoload and file headers.
  • Templates and Smarty: template registration in both directions, <{ }> delimiters, $smarty.get escaping, the Smarty 5 API, and the template checks of the XOOPS 2.7.4 upgrade preflight (unquoted xo* plugin arguments, includeq / foreachq, foreach item shadowing, strftime date_format).
  • Language files, installer SQL and deprecated core API (the 2.7.4 deprecation list).

Version-aware fixes

The plugin reads your tree's include/version.php and only offers rewrites your core supports. Older cores get compatible code instead of an API they don't have.

Productivity

  • New → XOOPS Module… scaffolds a legacy or hybrid module (Helper, PSR-4 autoloader, Xmf admin) whose output passes every inspection.
  • Completion, Ctrl+B and Find Usages for language constants (_MD_*, _MI_*, _AM_*…), including in Smarty templates.
  • Live templates for common XOOPS code.
  • A project tool window that gives an overview of your modules.

Getting started

Install the plugin and open a XOOPS project. Detection is automatic. You can set the Core Version and other options under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → XOOPS Support, and the inspections are listed under Settings → Editor → Inspections → XOOPS. The plugin installs and updates without an IDE restart.

Source, documentation and issues on GitHub
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 Alpha 4 (1.0.0-alpha.4)

A rebuild on the PHP PSI with 52 inspections (from 10). Every quick-fix is backed by a whole-file fixture and applied twice (idempotence); the set was tuned on 224 modules and on six full runs over XoopsCore27 (2,241 findings down to 666, none of them in test trees, every remaining one checked against the source).

  • Core version gate: isResultSet() (2.5.11) and exec() (2.5.12) rewrites are offered only when the tree's include/version.php has them; older cores get if (!$result) and queryF().
  • Direct-access guard recognises throw, compound conditions, status-line and return bodies; never guards an entry point or a bundled script that does not load XOOPS.
  • Superglobal rewrite leaves dynamic callees (new $_REQUEST['c']()) and non-XOOPS scripts (payment callbacks, bundled apps) alone; a $_POST = … write gets its own message.
  • Csrf recognises a dominating $xoopsSecurity->check() gate; Unlink recognises same-class helpers, realpath() aliases and files the script created itself; WeakToken treats an md5() password lookup as a migration path.
  • Template, language-constant and manifest rules skip tests/, testdata/ and fixtures/ trees; Smarty 5 rules stay silent on a core older than 2.8.
  • Bare -- lines in installer SQL are blanked; --text becomes -- text. The fix works in Inspect Code batch apply and survives "Remove trailing spaces on save".
  • unserialize() gets allowed_classes only where the result is used as an array.
  • Six template inspections ported from the XOOPS 2.7.4 upgrade preflight, for .tpl and .html on 2.5.11+ cores: unquoted xo* plugin argument (<{xoAdminIcons home.png}> → 'home.png'), includeq / foreachq → include / foreach and <{php}> reported, foreach item=x from=$x renamed to x_item through the loop body, block_parent / block_child → $smarty.block.*, strftime date_format → date() codes, and an opt-in Smarty 5 preparation report.
  • Unlike the preflight repair, arguments are always quoted with ' (most compiler.xo*.php plugins strip only '), a date format with literal letters is not rewritten, and a nested loop's from=$x.list is renamed with the outer item.
  • From rector_xoops: new ModuleAdmin() → \Xmf\Module\Admin::getInstance(); core includes of the deprecated class/xoopsobject.php, xoopsmodule.php, xoopsuser.php and mimetypes.inc.php stubs moved to kernel/ / include/; the eight deprecated xoops_load() short names ('cache' → 'xoopscache' …); and a new inspection for $xoopsOption[…] inside a function without global $xoopsOption.
  • Dynamic install and update without restart (language-constant cache is a project service).
  • Settings page (Core Version override, auto-scan, startup balloon), New → XOOPS Module… scaffold with a legacy or hybrid layout (Helper, PSR-4 autoloader, Xmf admin side) whose output passes every inspection, Tools → XOOPS Support menu, and Ctrl+B / Find Usages on language constants used as strings or in Smarty templates - all carried over from Alpha 3 and rebuilt.

1.0.0 Alpha 3 (1.0.0-alpha.3)

  • Goffy / wgSimpleAcc: inspections no longer report every finding twice (PHP+HTML PSI).
  • isResultSet quick-fix uses the current PSI statement (Inspect Code batch apply works); early-exit guards cover while (list = fetchRow).
  • ROOT_PATH guard: recognize die after namespace/use; insert after namespace; skip 404 stubs, admin entry points, and mainfile/header bootstraps.
  • Language constants: scan every language/**/*.php; Ctrl+B / Find Usages on _MD_* (and MI/AM/CO/MB).
  • Unregistered .tpl inspection (inverse of missing registered template).
  • XOBJ_DTYPE_UNICODE_* deprecation with rename quick-fix (off when Core Version is 2.5).

1.0.0 Alpha 2 (1.0.0-alpha.2)

  • Performance: Overview no longer auto-scans the whole module tree when the tool window opens (monorepo boot freeze). Click Refresh to scan. Optional setting re-enables auto-scan.
  • Scan tasks are cancellable; scanner cooperates with ProgressManager between modules/files.
  • Inspections appear under top-level XOOPS in Settings → Editor → Inspections (no longer nested under PHP).

1.0.0 Alpha 1 (1.0.0-alpha.1)

First public alpha of XOOPS Support.

  • Inspections + quick fixes: root-path guard, isResultSet before fetch*, query vs exec, deprecated DB API, templates, Smarty delimiters, Request
  • Live templates, language-constant completion, project scanner tool window, module scaffold
  • PhpStorm 2024.3+ (open-ended until-build, including 2026.2.x)
  • Dynamic plugin: load/unload without restart when possible
  • CI and GitHub Releases (tag must match pluginVersion)
